source_method: Third live fixed-broadband provider availability-checker expansion; provider primary HTML pages only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
Virgin Media, Community Fibre, KCOM, Trooli, BeFibre, Lit Fibre, Freedom Fibre and Connexin retained
Generic provider presence never treated as property serviceability
Separate live, coming-soon and register-interest states
Each checker only supports its own network/provider path
No runtime score changed without real runner evidence
